{{Quote|And Vonzel messed up an emergency landing; most of what's left of him will be in a life-support clinic for good. He started a regular one-man run on the organ banks.|Han Solo, to Roa|<ref name="hsr" />}}
'''Vonzel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked as part of an underworld crew led by [[Roa]]<ref name="hsr" /> on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In that [[Time/Legends|time]] Vonzel worked alongside fellow smugglers [[Tregga]] and the twins [[Lozira Briil|Lozira]] and [[Rewinda Briil]], and eventually, partners [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]],<ref name="hsr" /> who went on to great fame as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] heroes.<ref name="aoc">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref> At some point before [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], however, Vonzel suffered a brutal accident during an emergency landing, which required multiple organ transplants and left him an invalid. At the time Solo, who had kept in contact with many of his smuggling acquaintances, expected Vonzel to spend the rest of his life on life support.<ref name="hsr" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vonzel was first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1979]].<ref name="hsr" />
